mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_order (order_id, user_id, product_id, activity_id, source, price, status, paid_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{activityId}, #{source}, #{price}, #{status}, #{paidAt})
mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.product_id AS productId, p.title AS productTitle, p.cover_url AS coverUrl, o.price AS price, CASE o.status WHEN 1 THEN 'PENDING' WHEN 2 THEN 'PAID' WHEN 3 THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS status, o.source AS source, o.created_at AS createdAt, o.paid_at AS paidAt FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_product p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.order_id = #{orderId}
